1. Start with the test records.

completion:
When eg. a Live to Earth test fails START from Active rather than Earth continuity
3. Use a bigger circuit to see if you can get a reading eg Kitchen comes back with a R1+R2 of $0.25\Omega$ You now know the Earth arm of the loop is OK.
4. Go back to bedroom / bathroom and test for IZ taken from the bigger circuit and then calculate the Short Circuit Current Using $\text{Isc} = \text{Voltage} / \text{Earth Loop Impedance}$.

   i.e. $\text{Isc} = $

5. Next calculate Zs for that circuit
6. Check the appendix of the IE Annex up to 18th Edition BS7671 or Appendix 2 of the City and Guilds (CN) to see if the values for that circuit comply and if not the reasons why
7. NEVER record only
